summary: Repointed T088's current-evidence references from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; preserved T109 as historical read-only predecessor; kept T088 depends_on as [T084, T110] (T112 is inherited transitively through T084 per A0032 and T110 per A0035); preserved the Must-not block byte-identical with no weakening; added a References sentence noting T112 is the current registry-bound source and T109 is preserved as predecessor history. todo/config.yaml was not modified.
rationale: T112 is DELIVERED (APPROVED, replaces=[T109]) and is the documented current registry-bound product-run evidence source per A0026 impact A0026:T088:repoint-web-backtest-result-to-t112-when-approved. T088 is an indirect consumer of T109 (through T084 web-provenance and T110 replay) rather than a direct consumer; T084 already binds T112 directly via A0032 and T110 already binds T112 directly via A0035, so T088 inherits the T112 edge transitively through those two existing contracts and does not need its own depends_on extension in todo/config.yaml. The Owner direction in amendment-request.json explicitly forbids editing todo/config.yaml for this amendment and forbids adding T112 to T088 Dependencies. The T088 contract therefore only swaps current-evidence language in Deliverables, Acceptance and References from T109 manifest / ReplayFrame / cursor / simulation evidence to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; marks pre-T112 T109/T105/T063 manifests as historical; extends the old-path-unreachable predecessor list with T109 now that T109 is itself historical; preserves the A/B/C delayed-execution fixture reference (no explicit T109 tag); preserves the byte-identical Must-not block including its pre-T109 T105/T063 reconciliation ban. No business code, no workflow state, no Intent/Spec, no plan-structure revision, and no other task contract is touched.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. PROJECT_GOALS.md and the broader docs/intent/ surface are unchanged. A0041 operates only on a still-PLANNED P08 task contract that was naming a downstream T1xx sibling as its current evidence source. No product-intent question is reopened by repointing which T1xx sibling supplies T088's current evidence; the WEB-PAGE-013 page still has to teach, validate and bind to a current source.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md (the WEB-PAGE-013 and WEB-GLOBAL-* spec pages T088 implements), docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and the rest of docs/spec/ are unchanged. The current-evidence source naming in T088 is a contract-level binding, not a Spec statement. The Spec-level cutover from T109 to T112 was already recorded by the spec_revision v1-2026-09-23-a0026-run-evidence-cutover accompanying T112.
impact_assessment.contracts: Applicable: todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T088.md is the only contract edited. Its Dependencies line remains 'T084, T110' (no T112 edge is added in this amendment; T112 is reachable transitively through T084 per A0032 and T110 per A0035, per Owner direction). The Deliverables retarget: 'one chosen successful T109 run' to 'one chosen successful T112 run'; 'T109 cursor semantics' to 'T112 cursor semantics'; 'traceable to the T109 manifest, coverage, simulation evidence' to 'traceable to the T112 manifest, paired simulation evidence'; 'validated T109 artifacts' to 'validated T112 artifacts'; and 'Pre-T109 T105/T063 results and manifests' to 'Pre-T112 T109/T105/T063 results and manifests' so the historical group is explicitly named in cutover order. The Acceptance retarget: 'validated T109 artifacts record' to 'validated T112 artifacts record'; 'T109's post-event/post-transition semantics' to 'T112's post-event/post-transition semantics'; and the old-path-unreachable predecessor list 'T069/T105/T063' is extended to 'T109/T069/T105/T063' because T109 is now itself a predecessor publisher the page must not reconcile against as current. The Acceptance A/B/C delayed-execution fixture description is preserved unchanged (it has no explicit T109 tag). The References retarget: 'T109 (the current run, manifest, evidence and ReplayFrame authority; T069/T105 are predecessor history)' is split into 'T112 (the current registry-bound manifest and paired simulation-evidence source; the canonical dataset references and paired ReplayFrame this page consumes)' and 'T109 (historical read-only predecessor manifest and evidence pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; T069/T105 are predecessor history)'; the T040/T041 reconstruction composition line is retargeted from 'reconstruction T109 composes' to 'reconstruction T112 composes'; and a new References sentence is appended noting 'T112 is the current registry-bound source of manifest and paired simulation-evidence this page consumes; T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment'. The Must-not block (lines 92-102) is preserved byte-identical with no weakening; its 'pre-T109 T105/T063' reconciliation ban and 'no second fee, replay, backtest or accounting projection' clause remain binding. No other task contract is touched.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable. todo/config.yaml is not modified by this amendment, per Owner direction. T088.depends_on remains [T084, T110] (matches the contract's Dependencies line). T112 is reachable transitively from T088 through T084 (T084.depends_on already contains T112 per A0032) and through T110 (T110.depends_on already contains T112 per A0035), so the dependency DAG is not broken and no PLANNED direct consumer needs re-pointing for T088. The phase/active_task/workflow_state/intent_revision/spec_revision/agent_runtime top-level fields remain unchanged. No other task record's depends_on, replaces, superseded_by, lifecycle, claimed, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, latest_review or task_file field is touched.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. No business code is authored, modified, tested, reviewed or shipped. The T088 contract remains PLANNED with attempt=0 and no candidate or approved commit; no implementation gate is opened or closed. The Developer on a future T088 attempt will follow the updated contract and consume T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence through T110's ReplayFrame surface. The T109 contract's defective fixed-empty-source / fabricated-reference writer remains non-current for new runs under T112's runtime cutover clause and stays reachable only through the T069 entry for historical read-only / test fixture use, exactly as recorded by A0040 and the T112 review.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. No persisted artifact is created, modified, migrated, or reinterpreted. The amendment changes only which T1xx sibling T088 names as the current authority for the on-disk evidence and ReplayFrame; it does not move, copy, rewrite or relocate any manifest, report, simulation-evidence, dataset partition or replay frame on disk. Historical T069/T105/T063/T109 results and manifests stay byte-identical and read-only through the versioned legacy reader; only their rendering as historical is called out explicitly in the Deliverables pre-T112 clause.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. No runtime surface, CLI command, background process, replay path, lifecycle hook, restart behaviour or live-process contract is touched. T112's runtime cutover remains gated by T112's atomic-publication clause and by the reviewed SUPERSEDE amendment that will annotate T109 superseded_by T112; this amendment neither enables that cutover nor alters the fail-closed behaviour T088's Contract requires (an absent or non-validated evidence artifact already renders WEB-GLOBAL-002 unknown / fail-closed with a named reason). Browser restart semantics, deployment, and any signer/testnet/live authority concerns remain out of scope.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T088's WEB-PAGE-013 read-only page contract is unchanged in capability. No secret handling, authentication, signing, signer memory, keystore, wallet control, signing payload, endpoint secret, webhook credential, .env value or authorization-header surface is altered. The preserved byte-identical Must-not block continues to forbid granting approval, execution or promotion authority; the page remains a read surface only. T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence carry no private key, signing payload, endpoint secret or credential by contract.
impact_assessment.verification: Applicable at the contract-and-config drift level only: this amendment edits exactly one contract file (T088.md) and does not touch todo/config.yaml, so the controller's drift check at finish-amendment will see the T088 Dependencies line ('T084, T110') agree with todo/config.yaml's T088.depends_on field, with no T112 edge required in either surface for this amendment. No test, golden, fixture, oracle, tolerance or acceptance criterion is added, removed or relaxed; the existing T088 Acceptance clauses (WEB-PAGE-013 component/API mapping, marker rendering, PnL reconciliation, coverage gap rendering, hover/full-table layering, RELATIVE_ONLY handling, unknown-state rendering, checksum trace, post-event/post-transition semantics at pre-first-event/intra-block/end-of-block cursors, A/B/C delayed-fill fixture, T104 exact-equivalence, fail-closed named-reason rendering, migration-fixture legacy visibility, old-path-unreachable predecessor-publisher check, byte-identical historical T109/T105/T063 retention) remain the binding verification gate when T088 is eventually implemented. T088 itself does not re-test the T112 pipeline-repair invariants (real T100 partition resolution, block_range vs tick_range separation, fill-cursor preservation); those continue to be exercised by T112's own acceptance matrix.
